title: Back in Beijing, Jet-Lagged
description: Jet-lagged and just off a 12-hour flight from Vancouver, Steven describes the trip back to Beijing: crammed luggage, a customs check, a stubborn headache, his new teaching job and his YouTube plans. He ends by asking whether he really wants to stay in China for the long term.

sentences.zh: 内容速览
sentences.en: Content overview

sentences.zh: 史蒂文飞了12个小时，从温哥华回到北京，几个小时后就在公寓里录下了这期节目。
sentences.en: Steven flew for 12 hours from Vancouver back to Beijing, and a few hours later he recorded this episode in his apartment.

sentences.zh: 他时差没倒过来，边录边打哈欠。
sentences.en: He still has jet lag and keeps yawning while recording.

sentences.zh: 他聊了回家路上的种种：塞满的行李、海关检查、赖着不走的头痛，还有明天开始的新工作。
sentences.en: He talks about everything on the way home: overstuffed luggage, customs inspection, a headache that won't go away, and the new job starting tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 他也谈到YouTube计划，以及为什么总有陌生人问他是不是“油管博主”。
sentences.en: He also talks about his YouTube plans, and why strangers keep asking him if he's a "YouTuber."

sentences.zh: 最后他问了自己：回到中国，我真的开心吗？
sentences.en: Finally, he asks himself: now that I'm back in China, am I really happy?

sentences.zh: 答案可不是简单的一个“是”。
sentences.en: The answer is definitely not a simple "yes."

sentences.zh: 飞行与降落
sentences.en: Flying and Landing

sentences.zh: 上周史蒂文在加拿大航空吃了苦头：被要求托运随身行李，拉链还被弄坏了。
sentences.en: Last week Steven had a rough time with Air Canada: he was made to check his carry-on, and the zipper got broken too.

sentences.zh: 这次他早早在三号区排队，成功把行李塞进行李架。
sentences.en: This time he lined up early in Zone 3 and managed to squeeze his bag into the overhead bin.

sentences.zh: 他夸波音梦想客机的电子调光车窗，说这是“一架非常时髦的飞机”。
sentences.en: He praised the Boeing Dreamliner's electronically dimmable windows, calling it "a very stylish plane."

sentences.zh: 他被夹在靠窗的位置，旁边两位大人不想让他跨过去，所以他基本一动不动。
sentences.en: He was wedged into the window seat, and the two adults beside him didn't want him climbing over them, so he basically didn't move at all.

sentences.zh: 飞机下午4点50分左右降落。
sentences.en: The plane landed around 4:50 p.m.

sentences.zh: 入境很顺利，行李却等了30分钟。
sentences.en: Immigration went smoothly, but he waited 30 minutes for his luggage.

sentences.zh: 他还被“随机”抽中接受海关检查，同批的还有“一堆白人，真是太‘意外’了”，他猜是大胡子帮了倒忙。
sentences.en: He was also "randomly" picked for a customs inspection, along with "a bunch of white people, what a 'surprise'," and he guesses his big beard didn't help.

sentences.zh: 外国人小贴士： 现在住宿登记可以在网上填了，但竖屏时表格显示不全，把手机横过来就行。
sentences.en: Tip for foreigners: You can now fill out the accommodation registration online, but the form doesn't display fully in portrait mode — just turn your phone sideways.

sentences.zh: 行李、书和《末日逼近》
sentences.en: Luggage, books, and The Stand

sentences.zh: 史蒂文承认，大部分行李“可带可不带”：有纪念品，有女朋友点名要的食物，还有他想从加拿大清空的衣服和书：
sentences.en: Steven admits that most of his luggage was "optional": souvenirs, food his girlfriend specifically asked for, and clothes and books he wanted to clear out of Canada:

sentences.zh: 一本天主教会史。
sentences.en: A history of the Catholic Church.

sentences.zh: 他嘀咕：“为什么我不能直接在维基百科上看呢？”
sentences.en: He grumbles: "Why can't I just read it on Wikipedia?"

sentences.zh: 村上春树的《1Q84》。
sentences.en: Haruki Murakami's 1Q84.

sentences.zh: 全书约1400页，他已读了800到900页。
sentences.en: The whole book is about 1,400 pages, and he has read 800 to 900 of them.

sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·金的《末日逼近》。
sentences.en: Stephen King's The Stand.

sentences.zh: 这本书他背着走了三个国家，却还卡在第1380页左右。
sentences.en: He has carried this book through three countries, yet he's still stuck at around page 1,380.

sentences.zh: 他说：“我一定会读完的。”
sentences.en: He says: "I will definitely finish it."

sentences.zh: ‍ 新工作明天开始
sentences.en: New job starts tomorrow

sentences.zh: 新的教学工作明天就开始了。
sentences.en: The new teaching job starts tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 他很高兴这里没有上一所大学那么死板，不用跟所有人用同一份PPT，氛围可以概括为“随便”。
sentences.en: He's glad it isn't as rigid here as at his last university. He doesn't have to use the same PowerPoint as everyone else, and the atmosphere could be summed up as "relaxed."

sentences.zh: 他打算提前到校见人事部门，再熟悉一下教室电脑。
sentences.en: He plans to get to the school early to meet with HR and get familiar with the classroom computer again.

sentences.zh: 他最担心技术问题：有老师说教室的HDMI接口坏了，而去年他就为传课件折腾过。
sentences.en: What worries him most is technical problems. A teacher said the HDMI port in the classroom is broken, and last year he had a lot of trouble just getting his slides onto the computer.

sentences.zh: 温尼伯、温哥华和炸裂的头痛
sentences.en: Winnipeg, Vancouver, and a splitting headache

sentences.zh: 周六傍晚，他带着两个鼓鼓囊囊的大箱子离开家乡。
sentences.en: On Saturday evening, he left his hometown with two big, stuffed suitcases.

sentences.zh: 值机人员没怎么仔细称重，他说这算“走运”。
sentences.en: The check-in staff didn't weigh them very carefully, which he called "lucky."

sentences.zh: 他给温哥华的弟弟带了几瓶啤酒，住了一晚，第二天一早弟弟送他去机场。
sentences.en: He brought a few bottles of beer for his younger brother in Vancouver, stayed one night, and early the next morning his brother took him to the airport.

sentences.zh: 他在家乡只喝了两杯啤酒，醒来却头痛欲裂，一直疼到上飞机。
sentences.en: He only had two glasses of beer back home, yet he woke up with a splitting headache that lasted until he boarded the plane.

sentences.zh: 他猜可能是宿醉、脱水、戒咖啡因，或是时差。
sentences.en: He guessed it might be a hangover, dehydration, caffeine withdrawal, or jet lag.

sentences.zh: 他半开玩笑地说，这像是个“信号”，在提醒他要去哪儿。
sentences.en: Half-jokingly, he said it was like a "sign" reminding him where he was headed.

sentences.zh: 在机场，他给女朋友买了枫糖棒棒糖，还给她爸爸带了冰酒。
sentences.en: At the airport, he bought maple lollipops for his girlfriend and got ice wine for her dad.

sentences.zh: 机上剧集、小睡和消失的空镜头
sentences.en: In-flight shows, naps and the missing B-roll

sentences.zh: 他在飞机上看了《金装律师》第一集、《继承之战》第三季结尾，还重看了《办公室》第一集。
sentences.en: On the plane he watched the first episode of Suits and the end of season three of Succession, and rewatched the first episode of The Office.

sentences.zh: 他被“纽约人一眼就能看出西装便宜”逗乐了：“要是你怀疑那是不是便宜西装，那多半就是。”
sentences.en: He was amused by the idea that "New Yorkers can tell at a glance that a suit is cheap": "If you're wondering whether it's a cheap suit, it probably is."

sentences.zh: 他睡了两次，每次一小时，醒来腿肿了，幸好穿了压力袜。
sentences.en: He slept twice, an hour each time, and woke up with swollen legs; luckily he was wearing compression socks.

sentences.zh: 他还剪了四五条YouTube短视频。
sentences.en: He also edited four or five short YouTube videos.

sentences.zh: 整理素材时他发现，自己在美国和多伦多几乎没拍空镜头：“哪怕随便拍几个走路的脚也好……我怎么会忘了呢？”
sentences.en: While sorting his footage, he realized he had shot almost no B-roll in the US or Toronto: "Even just a few shots of feet walking would have done... How could I forget?"

sentences.zh: 这个频道最初是每周一期的语言学习播客，工作量太大，才改成一分钟的短视频。
sentences.en: The channel started as a weekly language-learning podcast, but it was too much work, so he switched to one-minute short videos.

sentences.zh: 现在他在考虑做长视频，因为YouTube对观看时长的回报高得多。
sentences.en: Now he's considering making long-form videos, because YouTube rewards watch time much more.

sentences.zh: “你是YouTuber吗？”
sentences.en: "Are you a YouTuber?"

sentences.zh: 又有陌生人问他是不是YouTuber。
sentences.en: Once again a stranger asked him whether he was a YouTuber.

sentences.zh: 这次是邻座乘客，一位来自长沙、现在住在渥太华的IT工程师。
sentences.en: This time it was the passenger in the next seat, an IT engineer from Changsha who now lives in Ottawa.

sentences.zh: 她喜欢渥太华，因为那里“冷清”，不像中国的机场和地铁那样人挤人。
sentences.en: She likes Ottawa because it's "quiet," not packed with people like airports and subways in China.

sentences.zh: 他说：“我宁愿YouTube的收入取代教英语的收入。”
sentences.en: He said, "I'd rather my YouTube income replace my income from teaching English."

sentences.zh: 不过，YouTuber这么容易被认出来，说明视频博主已随处可见，他担心自己“落后太多了”。
sentences.en: However, the fact that YouTubers are so easily recognized shows that video bloggers are now everywhere, and he worries he has "fallen too far behind."

sentences.zh: 邻座的她爱看外国人在中国生活的频道。
sentences.en: His seatmate loves watching channels about foreigners living in China.

sentences.zh: 史蒂文觉得这个领域大有可为，但中文还得加强，这样才能和当地人聊天，而不是只当个“城市导游”。
sentences.en: Steven thinks this niche has great potential, but he still needs to improve his Chinese so he can chat with locals instead of just being a "city tour guide."

sentences.zh: 时差、飞机餐和温暖的迎接
sentences.en: Jet lag, airplane food, and a warm welcome

sentences.zh: 晚上8点半，他眼皮已经直打架。
sentences.en: At 8:30 in the evening, he could barely keep his eyes open.

sentences.zh: 他的身体还在家乡时间，比北京慢13个小时，算时差实在“太费脑子了”。
sentences.en: His body is still on hometown time, 13 hours behind Beijing, and working out the time difference is just "too much brainwork."

sentences.zh: 飞机餐让人失望，尤其是“味道很恶心”的牛肉面。
sentences.en: The airplane food was disappointing, especially the beef noodles, which "tasted disgusting."

sentences.zh: 录到一半，女朋友带着欢迎的鲜花来了，花都已经蔫了。
sentences.en: Halfway through the recording, his girlfriend arrived with welcome flowers, which had already wilted.

sentences.zh: 她还提前给他过了生日，布置了生日装饰，又带了面条，所以他去Blue Frog吃汉堡的计划取消了。
sentences.en: She had also celebrated his birthday early, putting up birthday decorations and bringing noodles, so his plan to get a burger at Blue Frog was canceled.

sentences.zh: 我喜欢回到这里吗？
sentences.en: Do I like being back here?

sentences.zh: 史蒂文质疑“他一定热爱中国”这种想法。
sentences.en: Steven questions the idea that "he must love China."

sentences.zh: 他说：“对我来说，这就是一份工作。”
sentences.en: He says: "For me, it's just a job."

sentences.zh: 疫情期间他留下来，是因为这里有工作、有公寓、有女朋友。
sentences.en: He stayed during the pandemic because he had a job, an apartment, and a girlfriend here.

sentences.zh: 现在他在想，会不会有更好的选择，比如中东或南美。
sentences.en: Now he's wondering whether there might be better options, like the Middle East or South America.

sentences.zh: 他的家人没有一个想来中国。
sentences.en: None of his family members want to come to China.

sentences.zh: 几个月前的签证逾期还让他耿耿于怀。
sentences.en: His visa overstay a few months ago still bothers him.

sentences.zh: 他承认是自己的错，但说：“待了12年，一点宽容都没有。”
sentences.en: He admits it was his own fault, but says: "After 12 years here, not the slightest leniency."

sentences.zh: 好的一面是，他提前设置好了VPN，也很高兴回到自己的公寓，恢复健身的日常。
sentences.en: On the bright side, he set up his VPN in advance, and he's happy to be back in his own apartment and back to his workout routine.

sentences.zh: 他明白换个国家或换个职业，也会带来新的麻烦，所以还得好好想想。
sentences.en: He understands that switching countries or careers would bring new hassles too, so he still needs to think it over carefully.

sentences.zh: 今日总结
sentences.en: Today's Summary

sentences.zh: 史蒂文回到了北京，准备迎接明天新工作的第一天。
sentences.en: Steven has returned to Beijing, getting ready for the first day of his new job tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 离开九个月后，他依然不确定，中国是不是自己想长期留下来的地方。
sentences.en: After nine months away, he's still unsure whether China is a place he wants to stay long-term.

vocab.en: to be unable to let go of something; to brood over
optional; take it or leave it
